subject: maths
question: Mona purchased two sets of jewellery for Rs. 4,000 each. She sold these sets of jewellery, gaining 8% on one and losing 6% on the other. Calculate her total loss or gain in this whole transaction.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When Cost Price (CP) is same for both items:

Net Gain/Loss = Total Profit Value − Total Loss Value

⇒ Net Gain/Loss = (8% of 4000) − (6% of 4000)

⇒ Net Gain/Loss = 2% of 4000 = 80

⇒ Since the result is positive, it is a gain of Rs. 80.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 80 gain.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

CP of each jewellery set = Rs. 4000

Profit% on 1st set = 8%

Loss% on 2nd set = 6%

**Formula Used:**

Profit or Loss = CP × (Profit or Loss % / 100)

 Transaction Breakdown
 
 
 Set 1: CP = 4000
 

 +8% Gain
 
 
 Set 2: CP = 4000
 

 −6% Loss
 
 
• 
 Total Result = Gain (320) − Loss (240) = Rs. 80
 
 
 
 

 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total CP = 4000 + 4000 = Rs. 8000

⇒ Profit on the first jewellery set = 4000 × (8 / 100) = Rs. 320

⇒ Loss on the second jewellery set = 4000 × (6 / 100) = Rs. 240

⇒ Total Gain/Loss = 320 − 240 = +80

⇒ Since the net value is positive, it is a gain of Rs. 80.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 80 gain.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Case of Same Cost Price (CP)

If two items are bought at the same CP, the net profit or loss percent is simply the arithmetic average of individual profit/loss percentages: Net % = (P1% ± L2%) / 2.

Case of Same Selling Price (SP)

If two items are sold at the same SP, one at x% profit and another at x% loss, there is always a net loss of (x² / 100)%.

Profit and Loss Percentage

Profit % = (Profit / CP) × 100 | Loss % = (Loss / CP) × 100. Profit and loss are always calculated on the Cost Price unless specified otherwise.</p
